lines.beaver_en: Hello. How can I help you?
lines.en: Hello. I'm thinking of going to the tourist info center.

lines.beaver: 관광 안내소는 일 층 중앙에 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: The tourist info center is in the center of the first floor.
lines.beaver_roman: gwangwang annaesoneun il cheung jungange isseoyo.
lines.en: The center? Is it close to the entrance?

lines.beaver: 네, 입구 앞쪽으로 쭉 가시면 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, just go straight ahead from the entrance.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, ipgu apjjogeuro jjuk gasimyeon dwaeyo.
lines.en: Do they have regional travel maps there too?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, they have maps of the southern region too.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 남쪽 바다에 가 볼까 해요.
lines.en: Great. I'm thinking of visiting the southern sea.
lines.roman: joayo. namjjok badae ga bolkka haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Is there anywhere else you're going?
lines.learner: 카페에도 갈까 해요. 카페 위치가 어디예요?
lines.en: I'm thinking of going to the café too. Where is it?
lines.roman: kapeedo galkka haeyo. kape wichiga eodiyeyo?

lines.beaver_en: The café is on the outer side of the building.
lines.en: Outside? Which door do I go out through?

lines.beaver_en: Go out through the door on the right.
lines.en: Is the restroom upstairs or downstairs?

lines.beaver_en: It's downstairs, on basement level one.
lines.en: Then I'm thinking of taking the stairs down.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, take the stairs in front of the entrance.
lines.learner: 네. 건물 출입은 몇 시까지 돼요?
lines.en: Okay. Until what time can I enter the building?
lines.roman: ne. geonmul churibeun myeot sikkaji dwaeyo?

lines.beaver: 저녁 여덟 시까지 출입할 수 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: You can come and go until 8 p.m.
lines.beaver_roman: jeonyeok yeodeol sikkaji churipal su isseoyo.
lines.en: Got it. Thank you so much.
